question: How was this hard-to-worship vidyā given to me by you?
premises: The verse asks how the vidyā was given.
It calls the vidyā hard to worship.
inference: The sage questions how such a hard-to-worship vidyā was given to him.
uncertainties: The addressee is implied as Brahmā.
plain_english: How was this hard-to-worship vidyā given to me by you?
